boardPreamble: This board will notify you of currently active mini world changes all over Tibia.

guideMessages.text: Horestis near Ankrahmun is slumbering in his tomb.
The great Pharaoh Horestis near Ankrahmun has risen from his slumber to crush all intruders.
Horestis's body has been desecrated. His curse now hangs over Ankrahmun like the shadow of the vulture and his tomb is almost empty.
Horestis's body has been desecrated. By now, his curse has ended though. His minions are recovering slowly.

states.label: Mage at his tower, portal open

guideMessages.text: The raging mage is currently in his tower in Zao and experimenting with the portal into another dimension.
The raging mage in Zao has been slain and the portal into another dimension will close.
The strange tower with the servants on Edron is covered in slime.
The strange tower with the servants on Edron currently seems to be completely impassable because of a severe slime outbreak.

states.label: Broken out, feverish citizens in the streets

guideMessages.text: The swamp fever in Venore is currently under control and there is enough medicine for everyone.
The swamp fever in Venore is currently under control, but medicine is direly needed to prevent the next outbreak.
The swamp fever has broken out in Venore and feverish citizens are roaming the streets.

states.label: Burning, but the fire is being fought back

guideMessages.text: Countless firestarters are in their cells below Shadowthorn, but right now they are safely guarded.
alsoMatches: Countless firestarters are in their cells bellow Shadowthorn, but right now they are safely guarded.

guideMessages.text: Most guards and elves preventing the firestarters from breaking out have been slain. Shadowthorn is in danger of being set ablaze.
Shadowthorn burns, and the followers of the bog with it!
Shadowthorn burns, but the Tibians have been successfully fighting the fire as well as the firefighters.

states.label: Corpses piling up, about to turn dirty

guideMessages.text: The great lake near Port Hope is clean.
Corpses are piling up in the great lake near Port Hope and the water is about to become dirty
The great lake near Port Hope is dirty. Shimmer swimmers can be seen under the surface.
The great lake near Port Hope is dirty. No shimmer swimmers have been seen under the surface for quite some time now.
The mine tunnels under Kazordoon are currently flooded. Coal is needed to get the waterpumps running.
The mine tunnels under Kazordoon are currently flooded, but enough coal has been delivered to keep the waterpumps running.
The water in the mine tunnels under Kazordoon is drained and enough deeplings have been killed today to ensure it remains that way.
The water in the mine tunnels under Kazordoon is drained, but deeplings are trying to flood the mines again.
Too many deeplings survived during the last five days, they will flood the tunnels and nothing can stop them.
The steamship from Thais to Kazordoon is currently not running - coal is needed to activate the service once again.
The steamship from Thais to Kazordoon is currently not running, but enough coal has been delivered to start the working week tomorrow.

states.label: Horses on the loose, service on hold

guideMessages.text: The horse services near Thais and Venore are working normally.
Horses are on the loose near Thais! As long as there haven't been enough horses chased back into the pen, the service is on hold.

states.label: Starving wolves, no deer will return

guideMessages.text: There are white deer roaming the region near Ab'Dendriel. Don't slay too many of them, or they will leave the region.
The number of white deer near Ab'Dendriel seems to be dwindling. If that continues, we will have to watch out for some starving wolves.
Too many white deer have already been slain near Ab'Dendriel. Their population will leave the region soon.
Starving wolves are roaming the region near Ab'Dendriel. As long as they are there, no white deer will return.
Starving wolves are roaming the region near Ab'Dendriel, but enough have been driven away and the deer population will return soon.
The demon war is in a stalemate once again.
The Shaburak demons are in advantage right now.
alsoMatches: The Shaburak are in advantage right now.

guideMessages.text: The Shaburak have summoned their leaders and dominate the complex.
The Askarak demons are in advantage right now.
The Askarak are in advantage right now.
The Askarak have summoned their leaders and dominate the complex.

states.label: Awake, Renegade Quara control sunken Oramond

guideMessages.text: The Fire-Feathered Serpent is fast asleep.
The Fire-Feathered Serpent dreams and the earth is bleeding lava.
The Fire-Feathered Serpent is awake. Renegade Quara control the sunken regions of Oramond.

states.label: Floodgates to the Drowned Library open

guideMessages.text: The creatures of the deep are currently hiding in the black waters beneath.
God-king Qjell seems to be pleased, the floodgates to the Drowned Library have opened.
The inner arcanum of the deep has been breached.
The hive is well defended and prepared for war.
The defences of the hive are breached. The hive structure to the east is open.
The hives defences have fallen. Its armies are confused and in shambles. All structures are open for invaders.

boardMessages.text: A fiery fury gate has opened near one of the major cities somewhere in Tibia.
A hive infestation has been sighted south-west of Liberty Bay! An unnerving humming and buzzing is filling the air.
Bibby Bloodbath and her crew are roaming the lands, destroying everything in their path.
In case you have some spare tentacle pieces, you can now use Devovorga's very essence to enter a boss lair!
A big iceberg has been washed up at the coast north of Port Hope. It seems to be inhabited by strange white furballs.
Adventurers have told of a Spirit Gate in the Daramian mountains. Fight the restless undead!
Adventurers have told of a Spirit Gate in the Ghostlands. Fight the restless undead!
Adventurers have told of a Spirit Gate in Vengoth. Fight the restless undead!
A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the northernmost coast!
A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the Ankrahmun tar pits!
The volcano on Goroma sends its fiery message into the sky. A lot of creatures are flooding the lands together with its lava.

variants.label: South of the Ancient Ruins Tomb
Northeast of the Ancient Ruins Tomb

boardMessages.text: Nomads travel the eternal sands of Ankrahmun's desert. There must be a camp somewhere.
Sharpen your sword! The witch Wyda seems to be bored so pay her a visit!
Not again! Noodles has taken some royal freedom and left the castle, after him in the name of the king!
Hail to the King! It's Kingsday in Thais, join the celebration!
Judging by the unnerved mammoths in Svargrond, enough snow has melted away to reveal some very special flora.
A whole nest of spiders needs to be exterminated as Mamma Longlegs is on the loose.
The wild animals north of the Green Claw Swamp clearly dominate the area. But poachers come here to hunt them.
Poachers are ravaging the wildlife north of the Green Claw Swamp. But the animals seem to fight back!
Poachers have slaughtered nearly all wild animals north of the Green Claw Swamp. But vengeful spirits show up there now!
Strange sounds echo through Trapwood as hunters and dworcs fight over the holy grounds and the game that roams there.
The full moon has a strange impact on the island of Grimvale. The small forest there seems darker, filled with nightly howls.
Stampede! The Ape God has stirred up Tiquanda's elephants again!
Several banks in major coastal towns are being robbed! The thieves are still on the loose!
The river in Zao Steppe runs deep, there may be more fish than usual!
Looks like the Queen's own royal trees are being cut down! The lumberjacks responsible shall be put to justice.
The river south of the outlaw camp is flooding. A small island there should now be reachable safely.
An ice bridge now connects Svargrond to a frosty island, where monsters and a strange frozen creature have been sighted.
